name: Practice set (public)
system: Reply with only the final answer. No explanation.

items.prompt: A train leaves at 9:40 and arrives at 13:05 the same day. How many minutes does the trip take?
Which planet has the shortest year? A) Venus B) Mercury C) Mars D) Earth. Answer with the letter.
What is the capital city of Australia?
A shop sells pens at 3 for 2 dollars. How many dollars do 27 pens cost?
Which chemical element has the symbol Fe?
A rectangle measures 12 cm by 7.5 cm. What is its area in square centimeters?
Which of these numbers is prime? A) 51 B) 57 C) 59 D) 63. Answer with the letter.
Write the word necessary backwards, in lowercase.
How many seconds are there in 2.5 hours?
What is the next number in the sequence 2, 6, 12, 20, 30?
Who wrote the novel Pride and Prejudice? Give the surname only.
